rules.fno: every full setup on the F&O desk (regime prior + board + the future's own book on one side), long or short, 5% of equity each, marked at the underlying's close; stop = the desk's (2.5σ, 3–12%), target 2R, out at 15 sessions
rules.calls: every open call on the ledger, whichever model made it (stock-short, stock-long, wide-30, fno, fno-5, metals, the index rule), 5% each on the call's side; out when the ledger closes the call — due, stop or target — at the ledger's own exit
rules.tape: what the whole-market screen sees: early movers long (a new 20-week high with relative strength — stop 8%, target 16%, 20 sessions) and the 5-session ranker's five laggards short where a future exists (stop 6%, target 12%, 5 sessions)
